Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet West, Mid-Century, Oak Nightstand Bedside, 1-Drawer Table, 22"W, Dark Oak Finish
Colors: Brown
Materials: Solid hardwood
This mid-century nightstand's brass pull and concealed drawer glides provide a modern style, while veneer made from hand-selected quarter-sawn oak adds a distinctive grain. A back-mounted power outlet and two USB ports make it even more functional. 22"W x 16"D x 23"H Solid hardwoods with finish of wire-brushed matte dark oak Modern and simple yet distinctive design No assembly needed. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty. Drawer is suspended on easy opening, concealed, self-closing extension guides
